ns2:section.sectionText: ENG 298: Job Search 101 is a guided experiential learning course designed to prepare students for each stage of the recruiting process. Online lectures would present the basic material and would be supplemented with hands-on assignments that force the students to think from a recruiter?s perspective. Restricted to first and second year undergraduate students.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
